brand_identity.name: SAFYRA CHIKANKARI
brand_identity.tagline: Pure Handcrafted Lucknowi Chikankari • Stories woven across generations
brand_identity.positioning: Sophisticated Indian handcrafted luxury fashion house, specializing in 100% authentic handcrafted Chikankari, Mukaish, Badla, Zardozi, and Pitta work.
brand_identity.emotional_archetype: Luxury & Heritage (Archetype 5: Cinematic, warm, tactile, timeless luxury with warm ivory and deep dark chocolate brown)
brand_identity.design_tone: Editorial, spacious, dignified, authentic, warm, high-converting

theme_and_colors.theme_mode: Light (warm textile ivory palette with rich deep dark chocolate brown contrasts)
theme_and_colors.rules: DO NOT use dark blue gradients, generic bright tech colors, or pure #000000 black. Neutral tones must be warm-tinted with chocolate brown (#2C1A14) and ivory (#FDFBF7). Contrast must meet APCA standard (minimum 4.5:1 for body text).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous Spacing (Tailwind scale: p-4, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32). 2-3x roomier than standard store grids.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_rules: Use asymmetric product and storytelling grids (Tetris Grid Mode A) on homepage: hero spotlight span 8 cols, square feature span 4 cols, tall craft story span 4 cols row span 2.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Every section must default to 1 column on mobile, switching to md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 or lg:grid-cols-4 with touch-friendly swipe carousels and sticky add-to-cart bars.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, inputs, modals, navigation links, cart controls, wishlist toggles, filter options, and admin form inputs MUST have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, fully-functional, mobile-first frontend application for SAFYRA CHIKANKARI in React/JavaScript (using .js / .jsx files as standard for this codebase context).
Implement state management for products, wishlist, cart drawer, search query, selected filters, size/color selectors, and admin CRUD state.

Include pre-seeded realistic SAFYRA catalog data (Nazakat Collection, Vaaya Kota Doria, Aira Angrakha, Sang-e-Mar-Mar, Mehar Muslin Kurti, Noor Chanderi Kurti Set) with authentic prices (₹3,299 - ₹8,400), fabric descriptions, and making timelines.

Ensure all interactive flows work seamlessly: Filter/sort catalog, Search overlay, Wishlist toggle, Cart drawer update with quantity & total calculation, Size guide modal, Contextual WhatsApp links with product context, and Admin Panel to create/update products.
Never use generic AI colors, placeholder images, or low-quality layouts. Maintain the warm ivory and deep dark chocolate brown aesthetic throughout.
